Mary and Joseph walk Jerusalem in fear.

[TODO:tr] Remain where they will find you

Wait where you belong.

teachers.text:
[TODO:tr] The elders ask many questions.
They wait for your answer.

silent_consequence.title: [TODO:tr] Speak Gently
silent_consequence.text:
[TODO:tr] Truth lives within you.
Let it be heard.

choices.feedback: [TODO:tr] Your soft voice fills the room.

boast_consequence.title: [TODO:tr] Be Humble
boast_consequence.text:
[TODO:tr] Wisdom is not for boasting.
Speak with quiet grace.

reunion.title: [TODO:tr] Mary Finds You
reunion.text:
[TODO:tr] She weeps:
"Why have you done this to us?"

choices.feedback: [TODO:tr] She holds the words in her heart.
[TODO:tr] Do not run from her love.

blame_consequence.title: [TODO:tr] Speak with Love
blame_consequence.text:
[TODO:tr] She is your mother.
Answer her with grace.

shame_consequence.title: [TODO:tr] Stay With Her
shame_consequence.text:
[TODO:tr] She has searched three days.
Give her the truth.

return.title: [TODO:tr] Home to Nazareth
return.text:
[TODO:tr] You walk with them under the dawn.
You grow in wisdom and grace.
